chunks: Alī ibn Ibrāhīm, de su padre, de Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā, de uno de sus compañeros, de Abū ʿAbdillāh (la paz sea con él), quien dijo:
Todo aquello con lo que te hablas a Alá durante la oración obligatoria, no hay problema con ello.
ai.seo_question: ¿Qué se puede recitar como súplica durante la oración obligatoria en el islam chií?
ai.summary: Reported by Imam al-Sadiq (AS) in al-Kafi, this hadith clarifies that the supplications recited within the obligatory prayer are not limited to specific fixed texts, allowing for personal invocation. This ruling underscores the flexibility of the 'Qunut' or internal du'a in Shia jurisprudence, encouraging believers to engage directly with Allah in their own words during the standing position of prayer. It reflects the broader Shia emphasis on the spiritual intimacy and accessibility of prayer beyond rigid formalism. (Translated to Spanish):
